messages:
Maya (PM): Quick thread to align on launch criteria for Tenant Isolation v1 — need a crisp ops-safe plan for quantized model rollouts and eviction behavior. Customers expect predictable latency; we can't promise dedicated GPUs for all.

Diego (Eng): Summary from eng: we can implement eviction-aware scheduling + a fast fallback path. Two engineering items: scheduler hooks to prefer pinned nodes, and a soft-eviction signal to runtime. ETA ~10 dev days total with infra support.

Priya (Runtime): Runtime constraints: when we switch to a quantized variant there's a compile step + cache warm. Cold-switch p95 can jump ~250-400ms depending on seq len. If we make the switch async and serve fp16 until warm, p95 stays much tighter. Propose an async swap API: `swap_model_async(tenant_id, variant)` that returns a warm-status event.

Omar (Infra): Infra note: nodePools by priority + a taint/toleration scheme will work. For pilot (<=8 tenants) we can carve 2 GPUs from test fleets, but need capacity decision by Thu 6pm. Also need autoscaler prewarm hooks wired so nodes come up before traffic ramps.

Jules (Security): Security requirements: model artifact attestations, KMS-scoped keys per-tenant, and audit events for every model load & swap. We also need a short SC-1 attestation doc for pilot customers. Without attestation, we limit to non-regulated tenants.

Maya (PM): Proposed minimal acceptance criteria for v1 (draft):
```
- per-tenant routing + model pinning
- async model swap with warm-status and fallback to fp16
- eviction policy: soft-evict -> drain -> hard-evict (with metrics)
- nodePool priority + autoscaler prewarm hooks
- KMS per-tenant + model-load audit events
- rollout: canary 1 (0.5% + warmers) -> canary 2 (5%) -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback on p95/p99 regression
```
Anyone think this is missing a critical piece?

Diego (Eng): Add: feature-flag gate + CI spike test that simulates noisy neighbor eviction. Also need an operational runbook for manual failover to baseline models.

Priya (Runtime): We'll add a warmers controller that can be scoped to canary windows. Also recommend capturing KV-cache snapshots to speed warm on variant compile. Small note: limit variants per tenant to 3 for v1.

Omar (Infra): I'll draft a PR for nodePool manifests and autoscaler prewarm. If PM approves reassigning test GPUs, I can free capacity by Wed EOD. Otherwise we'll need to delay pilot.

Jules (Security): I'll drop the attestation checklist + KMS steps by Tue AM. Will call out acceptable compensating controls if attestation can't be done for a tenant.

sched-bot: Reminder: capacity reassign window closes in 30h.

Maya (PM): OK — action items: Diego: CI spike test by Mon; Priya: warmers controller + variant cap; Omar: PR for nodePools + approval request to pause test fleets; Jules: attestation doc Tue AM. We'll reconvene Wed 9am if GPUs unresolved. Thanks!
